description: Status of a run_skill or try_skill run: running, pending_approval (a human must approve a gated step on the run page; tell the user and wait), completed (verdict, human approvals, healed version if any), failed, declined or expired. Set wait_seconds to long-poll. On this endpoint runs are started by try_skill (capped public replay); run_skill is in the local server.

run_id.description: run_id returned by run_skill or try_skill

wait_seconds.description: wait up to this long for the run to finish or pause (default 30)

name: skill_run_status
title: Check a skill run
